fact: As of December 2024 the government issued around 126,000 civil status documents in the North-East including 37,000 national identity cards, and in 2024 UNHCR reported 51.78% of IDPs and 46.01% of refugees held legally recognised identity documents and 0.42% of IDPs and 29.22% of refugees had a bank account.
title: 3.8.2. Refugees, asylum seekers and IDPs
